decisions.decision: Reclassify the 370,346,663 XRP movement as OUTSIDE_TRACKER_ATTRIBUTION_WITH_BITGO_CUSTODY_MIGRATION_STRONGLY_SUPPORTED. Do not call it sold, distributed to exchanges or free float. Nine inspected destination accounts were activated by the same BitGo-labelled wallet and show multisig control; beneficial ownership remains unconfirmed.

Use the Oct30 SEC 424B3 as primary evidence: all XRP initially at BitGo, 100% cold storage, 2-of-3 multisig, master key disabled, shared $250M insurance estimated at 36.9% of XRP value on Oct9; pledge/lend only when expressly directed.

Separate $214.1M cash used for an 84.366M XRP purchase from 388.911M in-kind XRP contributions, $30M convertible notes and the optional $76.8M gross/$74.4M net ELOC. Do not treat ELOC capacity as completed funding or new XRP demand.
Treat JPYSC issuance and JGB backing as actual stablecoin capital/collateral, Hyper Deposit as bank deposits, and XRP card/reward redemptions as unknown until aggregate conversion data is disclosed.
Model SBI as a multi-rail ecosystem: XRP remittance/rewards, JPYSC, DCJPY, USDC/RLUSD and exploratory JPYSC/OUSD interoperability. Do not infer that all SBI activity uses XRP.
Keep Japanese SBIC SME investment/consultation companies separate from SBI Holdings, SBI Shinsei Bank and SBI VC Trade. ChatGPT seminars are education, not an OpenAI or XRP partnership.
Permission Coin ASK is a candidate for the phrase 'ASK Coin'; no XRPL contract or direct XRP integration found. Keep exact phrase origin unresolved.

The interview supports Dr Kamilah Stevenson using Camilla/Kamilla variants and the self-described YouTube name 'doctor Camilla Stevenson'. The channel ID is a strong candidate but not officially cross-linked; video inventory remains incomplete.
The Japanese 2026 FIEA amendment was enacted as Law No.64 on July 23; the reviewed primary law does not name XRP in a definitive asset list. Do not claim XRP is already specifically designated.
CoinGlass, CoinGecko and Liqwall open-interest observations remain separate and are quarantined from model features until venue, contract and timestamp coverage is normalized.
No directional XRP forecast is issued from Evernorth custody movements, SBI announcements or provider-disagreeing market data.
